title: Out-of-feature-class directional advection falsification

frozen_components.state_representation: Phase-10 RVQ initial state plus 18-bit companded innovation tokens
frozen_components.feature_library: exact frozen Phase-10 16-feature symmetric spatial/polynomial basis

unseen_law.name: periodic 2-D directional advection-diffusion
unseen_law.update: x_next = x - dt*(vx*Dx(x)+vy*Dy(x)) + dt*nu*Laplacian(x), independently per channel
unseen_law.reason_out_of_class: the frozen 16-feature basis contains symmetric neighbor sums but no antisymmetric first-derivative/directional-gradient features, so the exact directional advection operator is not in the frozen linear feature span

primary_gate: PASS only if frozen 16-feature companded context-8 model has error/persistence < 1.0 on all 4 splits in all 3 registered replicates (12/12); otherwise FAIL

diagnostic_controls.raw_frozen16: same 16-feature estimator fit from raw context; diagnostic only
diagnostic_controls.raw_directional20: expanded raw-only control adding centered Dx,Dy for both channels; diagnostic only and cannot redefine PASS
diagnostic_controls.purpose: distinguish representation failure from frozen hypothesis-class failure

classification_rule.frozen16_fails_directional20_passes: evidence that the current bottleneck is the hand-designed feature/hypothesis class rather than state-token capacity
classification_rule.both_fail: task/numerics or insufficient context remain plausible
classification_rule.frozen16_passes: the frozen basis approximates this regime well enough; a harder out-of-class law is required

failure_policy: No retries, replacement seeds, threshold changes, or rescue tuning. Persist unfavorable results.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law falsification only; no novel-physics or general scientific-discovery claim.
